limitations: Each variant owns an isolated persistent process; workers are exercised serially, and caches are not shared across variants.
All source normalization, planning, JS/Rust analysis and manifest consumption happen inside the timed compilation.
One balanced order cycle of warmups follows one correctness compile; these measurements describe warm compilation only.
control-js uses identical TypeScript stripping hooks without changing compiler logic, separating loader/code-generation effects from batching.
IPC, output serialization, equality checks and metrics snapshots are outside the timing window.
RSS is the root worker snapshot immediately after compilation, not peak RSS or the process-tree total.
Every returned value, source map, warning and expected error is compared using complete JSON output on every invocation.
A single shared-machine run is not formal build/HMR performance acceptance or evidence to enable native by default.
Identity checks cover the listed diagnostic sources, compiler TypeScript source tree, native binary and lockfile; installed transitive dependency files are not rehashed.

report.scope: All timing samples in this first attempt
report.reason: The process monitor expanded descendants of ancestor PIDs and could hide sibling tasks. Correctness comparisons remain valid; timings are not accepted.

firstAttempt.decision: All timings excluded due process monitor ancestry bug; four variants also lack loader control.

secondAttempt.decision: Retail excluded for concurrent work. Pressure exploratory only; no control-js, no replicated three-corpus result. No Rust performance conclusion accepted.

limits: Warm complete compiler calls using fixed options, not cold builds or Vite/HMR.
Same-loader controls required to distinguish loader/code generation, JS caching and Rust.
Root worker RSS immediately after compile is not peak/process-tree RSS.
External tasks are preserved; a concurrent run invalidates timings and stops later corpora.

windowsStage.rootCause: Relative pnpm links fail to resolve under the staged outer node_modules junction on Windows. Original test used absolute inner junctions and missed this shape.
windowsStage.fix: Materialize node_modules and scope directories on Windows, resolve dependency targets before creating absolute junctions, copy regular metadata, and verify direct package.json before require.resolve.
